name: India
cultural_context: Rich oral and epic tradition spanning millennia; Panchatantra, Jataka tales, Baital Pachisi, Yakshas, Daayans, Vetala lore, and contemporary urban legends (e.g. Nale Ba, Sanjay Gandhi National Park phantom hitchhikers).
cultural_context_notes: Rich oral tradition, regional diversity (Panchatantra, Jataka tales, Baital Pachisi, Yakshas, Daayans, modern haunted sites and paranormal rumours).

name: United States
cultural_context: Colonial folklore, regional tall tales (Paul Bunyan, John Henry), distinct Indigenous oral traditions (attributed with tribal nation sovereignty), modern cryptids (Mothman, Jersey Devil, Bigfoot), and classic contemporary urban legends.
cultural_context_notes: Colonial folklore, regional tall tales, distinct Indigenous oral traditions (handled with distinct tribal attribution), modern cryptids (Mothman, Jersey Devil), and classic urban legends.

name: Japan
cultural_context: Extensive yōkai, yūrei, and kaidan traditions documented from the Edo period (Toriyama Sekien) through modern times; school ghost lore (gakkō no kaidan), Kuchisake-onna, Teke Teke, and cursed digital media legends.
cultural_context_notes: Extensive yōkai, yūrei, and kaidan traditions; modern school ghost stories (gakkō no kaidan), Kuchisake-onna, Teke Teke, and cursed media urban legends.

name: Mexico
cultural_context: Syncretic pre-Hispanic (Nahua, Maya, Zapotec) and Spanish colonial traditions; La Llorona, El Chupacabra, La Planchada, Nahuales, and contemporary urban legends of Mexico City metro stations.
cultural_context_notes: Syncretic pre-Hispanic (Nahua, Maya) and colonial traditions, La Llorona, El Chupacabra, La Planchada, and contemporary urban legends.

name: Ireland
cultural_context: Gaelic mythology (Tuatha Dé Danann, Fenian cycle), Aos Sí (fairies), banshees, pooka, National Folklore Collection (Dúchas / Schools' Collection), and modern haunted highways and phantom hitchhikers.
cultural_context_notes: Gaelic mythology, Tuatha Dé Danann, Aos Sí (fairies), banshees, National Folklore Collection archives, and modern haunted roads and phantom hitchhikers.

name: United Kingdom
display_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
cultural_context: Composite British heritage preserving English, Scottish Gaelic, Lowland Scots, and Welsh traditions; Arthurian legends, Black Shuck, Spring-heeled Jack, Highgate Vampire, and haunted London Underground stations.
cultural_context_notes: English, Scottish, and Welsh regional folklore, Arthurian legends, Black Shuck, phantom coaches, Spring-heeled Jack, and modern haunted tube stations.

name: Brazil
cultural_context: Syncretic folklore uniting Indigenous Amazonian, Afro-Brazilian, and Portuguese oral traditions; Saci-Pererê, Curupira, Boto Cor-de-Rosa, Iara, Loira do Banheiro, and contemporary urban legends of São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.
cultural_context_notes: Indigenous Tupi-Guarani, African diaspora, and Portuguese folklore syncretism; Saci-Pererê, Curupira, Boto Cor-de-Rosa, Loira do Banheiro.

name: Greece
cultural_context: Continuity between classical mythology and demotic folk culture (dimotika tragoudia); Kallikantzaroi (winter subterranean goblins), Vrykolakas (revenants), Nereids, Gorgons, and modern Athens subterranean tunnel lore.
cultural_context_notes: Ancient mythic continuity, Kallikantzaroi (winter goblins), Vrykolakas (revenants), Nereids, and modern Athens metro and highway urban legends.

name: China
cultural_context: Classical Zhiguai (records of anomalies) and Chuanqi tales; Pu Songling's Liaozhai Zhiyi, fox spirits (Huli Jing), hungry ghosts (Egui), Jiangshi (hopping vampires), and modern urban legends such as Beijing Bus 375.
cultural_context_notes: Classical Zhiguai and Chuanqi tales (Pu Songling's Liaozhai), fox spirits (Huli Jing), hungry ghosts, and modern urban legends such as Beijing Bus 375.

name: Nigeria
cultural_context: Oral literature, trickster cycles (Tortoise / Ijapa in Yoruba, Mbe in Igbo), Mami Wata water spirits, and vivid contemporary school and city urban legends (Madam Koi Koi, Bush Baby, phantom commercial buses).
cultural_context_notes: Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, and Edo oral literature, trickster tales (Tortoise / Ijapa), Mami Wata, and contemporary urban legends (Madam Koi Koi, Bush Baby).

name: South Korea
cultural_context: Dangun mythology, Dokkaebi (goblins/nature spirits), Gumiho (nine-tailed fox), Cheonyeo Gwishin (virgin ghost), and prominent modern legends (electric fan death, red paper blue paper, haunted school elevators).
cultural_context_notes: Dangun mythology, Dokkaebi (goblins), Gumiho (nine-tailed fox), Cheonyeo Gwishin (virgin ghost), and modern urban legends (fan death, subway elevators, red paper blue paper).

name: Philippines
cultural_context: Vibrant lower mythological creature traditions (Aswang, Manananggal, Kapre, Tikbalang, Tiyanak), epic chants (Biag ni Lam-ang), and legendary modern hauntings (White Lady of Balete Drive, Ozone Disco ghosts).
cultural_context_notes: Lower mythological creatures (Aswang, Manananggal, Kapre, Tikbalang), regional epics (Biag ni Lam-ang), and modern urban legends (White Lady of Balete Drive).

name: Indonesia
cultural_context: Archipelagic animist, Hindu-Buddhist, and Islamic syncretism; Kuntilanak, Pocong, Genderuwo, Tuyul, Nyi Roro Kidul (Queen of the Southern Sea), and modern railway crossing and haunted hospital legends.
cultural_context_notes: Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese animist and maritime traditions; Kuntilanak, Pocong, Genderuwo, Nyi Roro Kidul, and modern haunted railway crossings.

name: Egypt
cultural_context: Ancient mythological retellings, Coptic folk saints, Islamic-era folklore (Afrit, Jinn, El Nedaha / Siren of the Nile, Abu Rigl Masloukha), and modern urban legends surrounding Cairo's Baron Empain Palace.
cultural_context_notes: Ancient mythological retellings, Coptic folklore, Islamic-era folklore (Afrit, Jinn, El Nedaha / Siren of the Nile), and modern Cairo Baron Palace urban legends.

name: Germany
cultural_context: Grimm fairy tales (Kinder- und Hausmärchen), regional Sage legends (Pied Piper of Hamelin, Lorelei on the Rhine, Rübezahl mountain spirit, Wolpertinger), and modern Autobahn and Berlin ghost legends.
cultural_context_notes: Grimm fairy tales, regional Sage legends (Pied Piper of Hamelin, Lorelei, Rübezahl, Wolpertinger), and modern German highway / suburban urban legends.
